FORMULAS USED

Only two calculations drive the simulation

01

Euclidean distance

d(x,c) = √[(x₁−c₁)² + (x₂−c₂)² + (x₃−c₃)²]

Assign each student to the closest centroid using all three subject marks.

02

Centroid update

μⱼ = (1 / |Cⱼ|) Σ x

Replace each centroid with the mean marks of the students in its group.

WCSS = Σⱼ Σx∈Cⱼ ‖x − μⱼ‖² Lower WCSS means tighter groups.
